consequence.statement: The flag still works in 1.17 but is deprecated; the feature will be unconditionally enabled in v1.18, so the setting will no longer control it.
consequence.remediation: Stop setting the flag/Helm value before upgrading to v1.18.

original.statement: The cilium-agent flag --enable-k8s-terminating-endpoint (Helm enableK8sTerminatingEndpoint) is deprecated, and the feature will be unconditionally enabled in v1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-9113ff586fec] lists the flag under Deprecated Options in the 1.17 upgrade notes. It says the flag is deprecated and that the feature will be unconditionally enabled in v1.18. Nothing in it says the flag fails, is rejected or is ignored in 1.17, so the right kind is deprecation (review) with low severity.
